items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.
items.computation: Page 2 shows a scan of the formal delivery envelope (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) with 'zugestellt am 11.12.2025' (Thursday). Since a formal Zustellungsurkunde with the actual delivery date is present, the two-week Einspruch period runs from the proven delivery date, not from a fictional 3-day rule. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (11.12.2025) is not counted; the period starts 12.12.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a two-week period ends on the day two weeks later that corresponds by name to the day of the event: Thursday 11.12.2025 + 2 weeks = Thursday 25.12.2025. That day (Erster Weihnachtstag) and the next day, 26.12.2025 (Zweiter Weihnachtstag), are public holidays in Berlin; 27.12. and 28.12.2025 are Saturday/Sunday. Under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 29.12.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) once the Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed, i.e. the day after the Einspruch deadline of 29.12.2025, so on 30.12.2025 (Tuesday) — this assumes no Einspruch was filed, which cannot be confirmed from the letter alone. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day it becomes final is not counted; the two-week payment period starts 31.12.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Tuesday 30.12.2025 + 2 weeks = Tuesday 13.01.2026, which is a normal business day in Berlin, so no shift applies.

warnings: Both computed dates (Einspruch deadline 2025-12-29 and payment due date 2026-01-13) fall well before today (2026-09-26); if no Einspruch was filed, check whether the fine was already paid or whether further enforcement/reminder letters have since arrived, since this original notice would now be outdated.

The payment due date depends on the Bescheid actually having become rechtskräftig on 30.12.2025, which in turn assumes no Einspruch was filed within the deadline — this cannot be verified from the letter itself.

The IBAN DE07 1005 0000 0000 9900 07 is a validly formatted German IBAN, but as with any payment instruction from a letter, the account holder should be verified independently before transferring money.
This appears to be a fictional/sample document (labelled 'Muster' throughout, e.g. sender name, sample bank name, sample email domain), so it should not be treated as a real fine notice.
